title: DeepSeek API Workflows, Tool Calling & Cost Optimization
summary: Build high-throughput, low-cost applications using the DeepSeek API, prompt caching, and function calling contracts.
objectives: Integrate DeepSeek OpenAI-compatible API endpoints in TypeScript and Python.
Leverage automatic context caching for up to 90% input token cost reduction.
Build resilient tool-calling workflows with schema validation and retry policies.

sections.title: OpenAI-Compatible API with Context Caching
paragraphs: DeepSeek exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, allowing direct reuse of standard SDKs by changing `base_url`. Context caching automatically identifies prefix matches across requests, reducing input token pricing significantly.

code.label: DeepSeek Client with Tool Calling
code.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="your-deepseek-api-key",
    base_url="https://api.deepseek.com"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek-chat",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is 2+2?"}],
    stream=False
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)

activity.reflectionPrompt: How does prompt structure and prefix stability affect context cache hit rates?

questions.prompt: How do you maximize context cache hit rates on the DeepSeek API?
choices: Place static system prompts and persistent context at the beginning of the message array.
Change the system prompt randomly on every user request.
Send prompt requests only between midnight and 4am.
Use all uppercase letters in user prompts.
questions.explanation: Context caching relies on identical prefix matches from the beginning of the prompt; placing static system instructions and documentation at the prefix maximizes cache hits.
